"import os

# Beam parameters
L = 100.0  # mm (length along x)
H = 10.0   # mm (height along y)
T = 5.0    # mm (thickness along z)

# Material (steel)
E_steel = 210000.0    # MPa
nu_steel = 0.3
rho_steel = 7.85e-9   # tonne/mm^3

# Mesh counts (at the minimum specified)
nx = 16  # elements along length
ny = 4   # elements along height
nz = 2   # elements along width

# Doubled grid for C3D20 (mid-edge nodes too)
Nx = 2 * nx + 1   # 33
Ny = 2 * ny + 1   # 9
Nz = 2 * nz + 1   # 5

# Build nodes (grid ix, iy, iz -> id)
nodes = {}
node_id = 1
for iz in range(Nz):
    for iy in range(Ny):
        for ix in range(Nx):
            nodes[(ix, iy, iz)] = node_id
            node_id += 1
total_nodes = node_id - 1

# Build C3D20 elements
elements = []
elem_id = 1
for k in range(nz):
    for j in range(ny):
        for i in range(nx):
            n_list = [
                nodes[(2*i,   2*j,   2*k)],    # 1: corner
                nodes[(2*i+2, 2*j,   2*k)],    # 2
                nodes[(2*i+2, 2*j+2, 2*k)],    # 3
                nodes[(2*i,   2*j+2, 2*k)],    # 4
                nodes[(2*i,   2*j,   2*k+2)],  # 5: top face corner
                nodes[(2*i+2, 2*j,   2*k+2)],  # 6
                nodes[(2*i+2, 2*j+2, 2*k+2)],  # 7
                nodes[(2*i,   2*j+2, 2*k+2)],  # 8
                nodes[(2*i+1, 2*j,   2*k)],    # 9: mid edge 1-2
                nodes[(2*i+2, 2*j+1, 2*k)],    # 10: mid edge 2-3
                nodes[(2*i+1, 2*j+2, 2*k)],    # 11: mid edge 3-4
                nodes[(2*i,   2*j+1, 2*k)],    # 12: mid edge 4-1
                nodes[(2*i+1, 2*j,   2*k+2)],  # 13: mid edge 5-6
                nodes[(2*i+2, 2*j+1, 2*k+2)],  # 14: mid edge 6-7
                nodes[(2*i+1, 2*j+2, 2*k+2)],  # 15: mid edge 7-8
                nodes[(2*i,   2*j+1, 2*k+2)],  # 16: mid edge 8-5
                nodes[(2*i,   2*j,   2*k+1)],  # 17: mid edge 1-5
                nodes[(2*i+2, 2*j,   2*k+1)],  # 18: mid edge 2-6
                nodes[(2*i+2, 2*j+2, 2*k+1)],  # 19: mid edge 3-7
                nodes[(2*i,   2*j+2, 2*k+1)]   # 20: mid edge 4-8
            ]
            elements.append((elem_id, n_list))
            elem_id += 1
total_elements = elem_id - 1

# Boundary face node lists
nroot_nodes = sorted([nid for (ix, iy, iz), nid in nodes.items() if ix == 0])
ntip_nodes  = sorted([nid for (ix, iy, iz), nid in nodes.items() if ix == 2 * nx])

# Helper: write list with at most 16 comma-separated entries per line
def write_wrapped(f, items):
    for i in range(0, len(items), 16):
        f.write(", ".join(str(x) for x in items[i:i + 16]) + "\n")

# Write the input deck
with open("model.inp", "w") as f:
    # Heading
    f.write("*HEADING\n")
    f.write("Cantilever beam natural frequencies (C3D20)\n")
    f.write("L=100 mm, H=10 mm, T=5 mm; steel\n")
    f.write("\n")

    # Nodes
    f.write("*NODE\n")
    node_list = [(nid, L * ix / (2 * nx), H * iy / (2 * ny), T * iz / (2 * nz))
                 for (ix, iy, iz), nid in nodes.items()]
    node_list.sort()
    for nid, x, y, z in node_list:
        f.write(f"{nid}, {x:.6f}, {y:.6f}, {z:.6f}\n")

    # Elements
    f.write("*ELEMENT, TYPE=C3D20, ELSET=BEAM\n")
    for eid, conn in elements:
        # First line: eid + first 15 nodes = 16 entries
        first_chunk = [str(eid)] + [str(n) for n in conn[:15]]
        f.write(", ".join(first_chunk) + ",\n")
        # Second line: remaining 5 nodes (well under 16)
        f.write("   " + ", ".join(str(n) for n in conn[15:]) + "\n")

    # Material
    f.write("*MATERIAL, NAME=STEEL\n")
    f.write("*ELASTIC, TYPE=ISO\n")
    f.write(f"{E_steel}, {nu_steel}\n")
    f.write("*DENSITY\n")
    f.write(f"{rho_steel}\n")
    f.write("\n")

    # Solid section tied to the element set
    f.write("*SOLID SECTION, ELSET=BEAM, MATERIAL=STEEL\n")
    f.write("\n")

    # Node sets (graded by name)
    f.write("*NSET, NSET=NROOT\n")
    write_wrapped(f, nroot_nodes)
    f.write("*NSET, NSET=NTIP\n")
    write_wrapped(f, ntip_nodes)

    # Bo"
